learning_outcomes.text: Name the five senses and the body part used for each
Match everyday objects to the sense that notices them
Describe how sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch help us stay safe
Sort things by how they feel, sound, look, smell or taste
Explain that some living things use senses differently from people
Ask a simple question about the world and answer it by observing

integrative_case: A class visits a garden: the children use each of their five senses to notice flowers, birds, soil and fruit, then draw and tell which body part noticed each thing and which sense kept them safe near the bees.
